[[Category:Imperial Sodality]][[Category:388YE Summer]]
==Overview==
The [[Imperial sodality|Imperial sodalities]] of the Empire have potentially far-reaching powers. Each season, the members of Imperial sodalities meet to vote on elections, bequests, and other actions that their sodality might take. 

Where possible, the civil service records these votes and presents the results after each summit. 

==Apothecaries Guild==

==Cat's Graces==
===Appointments===
* '''Lady Ralphine Sepulchre''' was appointed [[Cat's Graces#Maestro|Maestro of the Cat's Graces]]
* '''João i Cabral i Riqueza''' was appointed [[Azure Sutannir]]
* '''Pjesmina Zbirka''' was appointed [[High Bard of the Empire]]

===Other business===
* '''[[Dean_of_the_First_Voice_Glade#First_Voice_Glade|First Voice Glade]]''' was selected as the location for a [[Arranging_grace#Art_for_Art's_Sake|repository of art]]
* The piece '''''[[Morning Light]]''''' was selected for [[Cat%27s_Graces#Preserve_Art|preservation]]
* The commission of '''[[Hand_to_the_Dance|Dancer's Rest]]''' was selected for [[Cat%27s_Graces#Refine_Commission|refinement]]
* No disbursements were made from the Patron's Fund; it ended the summit at 5 thrones

==Magpies==
===Appointments===
* '''Morgan Drifting Bough''' was appointed [[Magpies#Speaker|Speaker of the Magpies]]
* '''Caleb of the Cenotaph''' was appointed [[Golden Fleet Salvagemaster]]

==Sun Chamber==
===Appointments===
* '''Hazel Talbot''' was appointed [[Sun_Chamber#Counsel_of_the_Sun_Chamber|Counsel of the Sun Chamber]]

===Bequests===
* [[Sun_Chamber#The_Falling_Star|The Falling Star]] (3 rings of ilium) was awarded to '''Nina of Cantiarch's Hold'''
* [[Sun_Chamber#The_Line_and_the_Curve|The Line and the Curve]] (25 mana crystals) was awarded to '''Hazel Talbot'''
* [[Sun_Chamber#The_Wyrd_Stone|The Wyrd Stone]] (30 crowns) was awarded to '''Hazel Talbot'''

===Door of the Chamber===
* [[Sun_Chamber#Eternal_Allies|Eternal Allies]] was chosen
** The Sun Chamber requested [[Rhianos]] set them a quest to recover treasure and secrets lost to the [[Whisper Gallery]]

==Vallornguard==
===Appointments===
* '''Corwyn Heartsbane''' was appointed [[Vallornguard#Speaker_of_the_Vallornguard|Speaker of the Vallornguard]]
* '''Kevan Heartsbane''' was appointed [[First Thorn of the Vallornguard]]
* '''Bolegost Katrinavich Ozerov''' was appointed [[Burgher of Ketsov]]

===Bequests===
* [[Vallornguard#The_Bloody_Bequest|The Bloody Bequest]] (10 thrones) was awarded to '''Seren Embercast'''
